players.note: Payne (foot) underwent season-ending surgery Wednesday, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.

players.name: Dyami Brown
players.note: Brown has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams due to a calf injury.

players.name: Javon Kinlaw
players.note: Kinlaw underwent season-ending surgery Tuesday to repair his MCL, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Jer'Zhan Newton
players.note: Newton (pectoral) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Rams, Zach Selby of the Commanders' official site reports.

players.name: Jeremy McNichols
players.note: McNichols, who suffered a foot injury Sunday against the Eagles that may require surgery, is out for the season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Laremy Tunsil
players.note: Tunsil (triceps) could potentially return late in the season, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.note: McLaurin (knee) underwent surgery Friday to repair the torn patellar tendon in his left knee, Nicki Jhabvala of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Treylon Burks
players.note: Burks (foot) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Rams.
